batches.title: Hard-Boil Eggs for the Week (Mon–Fri)
steps: 1. Place 14 large eggs in a large saucepan; cover with cold water by at least 3 cm.
2. Bring to a rolling boil over high heat, then reduce to a gentle boil; cook exactly 10 minutes.
3. Transfer eggs immediately to a bowl of ice water; leave 10 minutes to stop cooking.

4. Peel all eggs and store in an airtight container in the fridge. They keep safely for 4 days (Mon–Thu). Boil fresh eggs on Friday if needed (already accounted for: Friday uses last 2 from batch or boil fresh).
yields: 14 hard-boiled, peeled eggs — ready to use Mon–Fri breakfasts and pm snacks

day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Breakfast — Kefir & Banana Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough: halve 2 (Diego) / 1 (Diana) pre-boiled eggs onto toasted sourdough; crumble feta; blend kefir-banana smoothie.
day_of_assembly.Thursday: Breakfast — Kefir & Kiwi Smoothie + Boiled Eggs on Sourdough: halve 2 (Diego) / 1 (Diana) pre-boiled eggs onto toast; add feta; blend kefir-kiwi smoothie.
day_of_assembly.Friday: ⚠ Cook fresh today — do NOT use the Sunday batch (eggs cooked is only safe ~4 day(s); this is day 5).

storage.safety_note: Hard-boiled eggs: 1 week in shell, 5 days peeled in water. Scrambled/cooked dishes: 3–4 days.

batches.title: Cook Quinoa Batch (used Mon lunch & Tue lunch)
steps: 1. Rinse 200 g dry quinoa under cold running water for 30 seconds in a fine sieve to remove bitterness.
2. Add to a medium saucepan with 400 ml cold water and a pinch of sea salt.
3. Bring to a boil over high heat; reduce to lowest heat; cover with lid; cook 15 minutes.
4. Remove from heat; leave lid on and steam 5 more minutes.
5. Fluff with a fork; spread on a large plate or tray to cool quickly (10 min).
6. Transfer to an airtight container; refrigerate immediately. Safe up to 3 days (Monday–Wednesday).
yields: ~480 g cooked quinoa — enough for Monday lunch (Diego 120 g / Diana 80 g) and Tuesday lunch (Diego 120 g / Diana 90 g)

day_of_assembly.Monday: Lunch — Mediterranean Beef & Chickpea Bowl: portion 120 g (Diego) / 80 g (Diana) cold quinoa into bowls; reheat in microwave 90 sec; top with freshly seared beef strips, roasted peppers and chickpeas.
day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Lunch — Asian Ginger Tilapia Bowl: portion 120 g (Diego) / 90 g (Diana) quinoa; reheat microwave 90 sec; top with freshly baked tilapia and stir-fried zucchini-carrot mix.

storage.safety_note: Add a splash of water before reheating to restore moisture. Use within 3 days.
